recreation_brief: 1. Create a slide with a light gray (#F5F5F5) background. 2. Add the title 'Neural Network Model' centered at the top in large bold dark-red (#8B0000) sans-serif. 3. Directly below, add the subtitle '(Weights of Output Layer AFFECTS Calculated Error)' in bold blue (#0000FF), keeping 'AFFECTS' capitalized. 4. Place a yellow (#FFFF00) circle at the extreme top-right with the number '7' in black. 5. Add a purple (#DDA0DD) rounded rectangle at the top-left labeled 'Input Sample'. 6. Add a purple (#DDA0DD) rounded rectangle at the top-right labeled 'Target Label'. 7. Draw the neural network: create three vertical columns of nodes. Column 1 (left): 4 blue (#4169E1) circles with white Σ, each followed by a pale-yellow (#FFFACD) square with ∫, then a small open circle. Column 2 (middle): 3 blue circles with Σ, each followed by a pale-yellow square with ∫, then an open circle; label 'Net_i' above and 'O_i' after. Column 3 (right): 3 green (#32CD32) circles with Σ, each followed by a pale-yellow square with ∫, then 'O_j'; label 'Net_j' above. 8. Connect every node in column 1 to every node in column 2 with thin black lines. Connect every node in column 2 to every node in column 3 with thin black lines; place small labels 'W_ji' and 'W_ij' on these connections. 9. Add a pink (#FF69B4) circle containing '1' at the bottom-left with the label 'Node Bias'; draw lines from it to the column-3 nodes. 10. Add a red (#FF0000) vertical box along the right edge with white text 'Error Error'. 11. At the far right, add labels 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m' next to the column-3 nodes, and 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m' further right. 12. At the bottom, add a green (#90EE90) box labeled 'Previous Layer Layer (i)' pointing to column 2, and another green box labeled 'Current Layer is Output Layer (You are here)' pointing to column 3. 13. Add the label 'For Layer "j"' at the bottom-left. 14. Add the label 'If Layer "j" is Output Layer:' at the bottom-right. 15. At the very bottom, place three equation blocks: left block with 'Net_j = Σ_i (w_ji O_i)' and 'O_j = f(Net_j) = 1/(1+e^{-Net_j})'; right block with 'E = 1/2 Σ_j (t_j - O_j)^2'. Use black text with proper subscripts.
